WITH
    trip AS (
        SELECT
            trip_id,
            fiskeridir_vessel_id,
            "period"
        FROM
            trips
        WHERE
            fiskeridir_vessel_id = (
                SELECT
                    fiskeridir_vessel_id
                FROM
                    all_vessels
                WHERE
                    call_sign = $1
            )
            AND trip_id = $2
    ),
    updated AS (
        INSERT INTO
            trip_fuel (
                trip_id,
                period,
                fiskeridir_vessel_id,
                barentswatch_user_id,
                fuel_liter_used
            )
        SELECT
            trip_id,
            period,
            fiskeridir_vessel_id,
            $3,
            $4
        FROM
            trip
        ON CONFLICT (trip_id) DO UPDATE
        SET
            fuel_liter_used = EXCLUDED.fuel_liter_used,
            fiskeridir_vessel_id = EXCLUDED.fiskeridir_vessel_id,
            barentswatch_user_id = EXCLUDED.barentswatch_user_id
        RETURNING
            trip_id,
            fuel_liter_used
    )
UPDATE trips_detailed t
SET
    trip_fuel_liter_used = u.fuel_liter_used
FROM
    updated u
WHERE
    t.trip_id = u.trip_id
